summary: Shattuck Labs filed an 8-K disclosing an underwritten public offering of 10,879,376 shares at $4.00/share plus pre-funded warrants for 7,870,624 shares at $3.9999/share, with a full underwriter option for 2,812,500 additional shares exercised. Proceeds go to the issuer. No premium, recommendation, or advisor named; the offering was conducted under an effective shelf registration. The warrants are exercisable immediately with a 4.99%-19.99% beneficial ownership blocker. Expected close is June 11, 2026. Watch for dilution impact and potential share price drift post-closing.
